description.p: Turn audio files and microphone recordings into text with local Whisper models. Audio and transcripts are not uploaded to a server.
Copy recognized text, export plain text, or create SRT subtitles with segment timestamps. Use CPU inference or Vulkan acceleration on a compatible GPU.
The rewrite view is currently a demonstration: it copies the original text unchanged and does not connect to an LLM.
Choose an existing whisper.cpp model or explicitly download one in Settings. Model files are not bundled; downloading models requires an internet connection and additional disk space.
Initial Linux release with local Whisper transcription, microphone recording, CPU and Vulkan inference, TXT/SRT export, and a demonstration rewrite view.
